comment: Hand-transcribed expected /ubus decisions from pinned C and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: JSON-RPC call params are [sid, object, function, data_table]. Missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE (-32700), not the all-zero sentinel and not rpcd file/uci if (!sid) return true.
uh_ubus_allowed invokes session.access with {ubus_rpc_session, object, function} and omits scope; rpcd defaults scope to ubus.
A present all-zero SID is RPC_DEFAULT_SESSION_ID and is still checked via session.access.

Unauthenticated ACLs grant only luci.getFeatures. They do not name getSwconfigFeatures, getSwconfigPortState, getRealtimeStats, setPassword, setLocaltime, getBlockDevices, setBlockDetect, getConntrackList, or getProcessList.
Delegated fixture logins grant only the matching luci-mod-* group. Matching methods ALLOW; unauthenticated is no-grant deny.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).

Emission is bounded to luci.getFeatures plus the inventoried request.args exec methods, getBlockDevices/setBlockDetect, and luci.sys getConntrackList/getProcessList. Do not emit file.exec, cgi-io, hostapd.*, or setInitAction (no luci-ssl delegated grant at this pin).
no_ubusauth=1 SID rewrite and uh_ubus_allowed skip are profile luci-ssl-25.12-no-ubusauth, not luci-ssl-25.12.
